name: vivaminima
description: Small local tools for Claude Code users. Free; Pro versions on Gumroad.

plugins.name: beginner-readme-section
plugins.description: A Claude Code skill that writes a "New to this? Start here" section at the top of a README.

plugins.name: checklist-stop
plugins.description: A Stop hook for Claude Code: the session cannot finish while your Markdown checklist still has an open item.

plugins.name: console-safe
plugins.description: Run a Python command-line tool under several console encodings and see where it dies.

plugins.name: context-file-audit
plugins.description: Measure what your CLAUDE.md and its @imports cost at session start. Python stdlib only, MIT.

plugins.name: go-no-go-verdict
plugins.description: Turn one idea into a decision with explicit assumptions and stop conditions. A Claude Code skill and a small checker.

plugins.name: handoff-check
plugins.description: Checks an agent's "done, I sent it" report against the disk and writes a verification receipt.

plugins.name: inbox-ledger
plugins.description: A receipt book for the folder your Claude windows use to pass notes: nothing counted twice, nothing lost, later edits detectable. One Python file, offline.

plugins.name: llm-budget-router-lite
plugins.description: Route LLM requests and see what each call costs. One local Python file, standard library only.

plugins.name: release-gate
plugins.description: A pre-release check for the ZIP or folder you are about to ship: keys, stray files, machine paths, version mismatches.

plugins.name: secret-map
plugins.description: See where API keys and passwords sit in a folder before you share it. Shows locations, never values. One Python file, offline.

plugins.name: skill-audit-kit
plugins.description: Find out why a Claude skill does not load, does not trigger, or eats your context. One Python file, offline, read-only.

plugins.name: skill-install-gate
plugins.description: Look at a Claude Code skill before you install it: a check of a temporary copy with one of three verdicts.
